## Checklist

- [ ] Tested locally with `npm run dev`
- [ ] Tested at mobile width (~375px)
- [ ] Light mode + dark mode both look correct
- [ ] EN and FR translations both updated if copy changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under `[Unreleased]` if user-visible
- [ ] No console errors or warnings introduced
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds locally if shipping logic changes

## Risk

- [ ] Low — visual / copy only
- [ ] Medium — touches routing, hooks, or shared components
- [ ] High — modifies translations structure, build pipeline, or env handling

## Follow-up

Anything intentionally left for a later PR? Note it here so it's not forgotten.
